content_sections.heading: How Will JIPMER Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Shortlisting based on application, CV, and documentary proof Written test Interview and skill test for shortlisted candidates Written Test covers Research methodology, educational research methods, competency-based medical education (CBME), clinical reasoning and assessment tools, basic biostatistics, ethics in research, and data interpretation. Interview and Skill Test covers research methodology, CBME and assessment strategies, Script Concordance Test development and validation, psychometric analysis, qualitative research, implementation research frameworks, ethical conduct, project management, and publication.

faq.answer: The last date is 20 October 2026.
